SELECT SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
       AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
       AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
       AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM web_returns AS wr
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd1 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT marital_status AS marital_status,
           education_status AS education_status,
           min_price AS min_price,
           max_price AS max_price
    FROM (VALUES
        ('D', 'Primary', 100.00, 150.00),
        ('S', 'College', 50.00, 100.00),
        ('U', 'Advanced Degree', 150.00, 200.00)
    ) AS v(marital_status, education_status, min_price, max_price)
) AS demo
    ON cd1.cd_marital_status = demo.marital_status
   AND cd1.cd_education_status = demo.education_status
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
    ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
   AND cd2.cd_marital_status = demo.marital_status
   AND cd2.cd_education_status = demo.education_status
JOIN customer_address AS ca
    ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
   AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
JOIN (
    SELECT state_name AS state_name,
           min_profit AS min_profit,
           max_profit AS max_profit
    FROM (VALUES
        ('NC', 100, 200),
        ('TX', 100, 200),
        ('IA', 100, 200),
        ('WI', 150, 300),
        ('WV', 150, 300),
        ('GA', 150, 300),
        ('OK', 50, 250),
        ('VA', 50, 250),
        ('KY', 50, 250)
    ) AS v(state_name, min_profit, max_profit)
) AS addr
    ON ca.ca_state = addr.state_name
JOIN web_sales AS ws
    ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
   AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
JOIN date_dim AS d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_page AS wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN reason AS r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 1998
  AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN demo.min_price AND demo.max_price
  AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN addr.min_profit AND addr.max_profit
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
         AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
         AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
         AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
